title: Rory and the Starry Blossom Cove
verses:
The sun tumbled down past the edge of the hill,
As Rory stepped down to the cove in the deep,
The ocean was calm and the valley was still,
Where blossoms were folding their petals to sleep.

High over the water came Nia to glide,
While Tilly walked softly through ribbons of sand,
They watched the cool foam of the slumbering tide,
Roll into the shore of the quiet green land.

Then Ricky crept over a mound of warm clay,
With Psittaco humming a melody sweet,
The bustle of morning had vanished away,
And stillness fell softly on scurrying feet.

Then Benny leaned low as the evening grew dim,
And Rory curled close in a bed by the shore,
The silvery waters were singing a hymn,
That whispered of dreaming and playing no more.

Now Psittaco tucked under Nia to rest,
As Ricky lay down with a comforting sigh,
The quiet green cove was a welcoming nest,
Beneath the vast quilt of the starry blue sky.

The blossoms were shut and the ripples were slow,
And Rory was drifting to magical dreams,
The world was asleep in a heavenly glow,
Surrounded by starlight and silver moonbeams.
